subject: Coverage gap watchlist + owner action grid (finance alignment needed)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@acme-corp.com>
Cc: procurement@nebula-sys.com
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage gap watchlist + owner action grid (finance alignment needed)

Team —

Attached is the initial coverage-gap watchlist for Acme (ACME-2027-Q3-0421). Finance flagged a potential shortfall for June/July consumption vs. what was committed in the SOW. I converted notes from the seller sync into a simple R/Y/G "owner action grid" to help us prioritize outreach.

Top asks:
- Rishi: can you confirm the current committed ARR number and whether we have approval to offer 10% credit for overage mitigation (finance will need official ok).
- Sean: please re-confirm technical sign-off date and whether the trial-to-paid metric will be met by the end of month.
- Laura / Procurement: we need a hard date for PO submission or DocuSign signature to avoid the coverage gap. If timelines slip we should discuss a short-term bridge.

Quick R/Y/G snapshot (see attached sheet for full details):
- Red: 2 blocks — primary blocker is procurement timing (owner: Laura / procurement@nebula-sys.com)
- Yellow: 3 blocks — finance approval pending for discount/credit (owner: Rishi)
- Green: 4 blocks — technical readiness on track (owner: Sean)

I attached the watchlist (acme_watchlist_sheet.xlsx) and the latest MOP terms we discussed (acme_mop_terms_v2.pdf). Please reply inline with updates by EOD Tuesday 2027-06-15 so I can escalate to FP&A if needed.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: acme_watchlist_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme_mop_terms_v2.pdf (PDF)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage gap watchlist + owner action grid (finance alignment needed)

Kimberly —

Thanks for the triage and the clear grid. Quick update from Finance: the committed ARR on record for ACME-2027-Q3-0421 is $420K (monthly run-rate equivalent $35K). Based on projected consumption the shortfall risk for July is about $9K — this is why I flagged credit discussions.

We can approve a one-time mitigation credit up to 8% under a formal variance memo, but anything beyond that will need VP sign-off and a short business case. If Sales wants the 10% comfort, we need the following by Tue EOD:
- A written runbook that shows how the credit is applied and clawback conditions
- An expected timeline for PO/signature (we can only record the credit after signed PO)

I added inline comments to the watchlist (see Drive link). I do not see a technical blocker on our side — Sean, if you can confirm the trial metrics we discussed, finance is comfortable moving forward with the internal variance route.

Rishi
Director, Revenue Ops & Finance Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nebula-sys.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coverage gap watchlist + owner action grid (finance alignment needed)

Hi Kimberly / Rishi —

Appreciate the clear summary. Procurement is the primary gate here — our internal PO approval calendar has a cut-off on 2027-06-20 for July billing cycles. I asked procurement@nebula-sys.com to push the PO up and to confirm whether we can expedite signature. Two quick items from our side:

1) We can accept a short-term bridge for three weeks (purchase order to follow) if we get written terms for the bridge (amount, billing dates, and any credit/carryover language). Please share a 1-paragraph bridge statement we can attach to the PO.
2) If Redwood can provide evidence of no technical/regression issues (simple health check), procurement will feel more comfortable approving early. Sean — can you share the last 7-day health summary?

I will aim to have PO status by Friday 2027-06-18. If it slips past 06-20 we will need to assess the billing impact.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Data & Platform | Acme Corp
laura@acme-corp.com

Laura/Rishi/Sean —

Thanks for the quick responses and the commitment dates. Consolidated next steps and the updated owner action grid below (finalized for escalation to FP&A if we still see risk after PO cutoff):

Owner action grid (final):
- Red — Procurement slip risk (owner: procurement@nebula-sys.com / Laura): PO target 2027-06-18; if PO not received by 06-20 finance will implement short billing hold until cleared.
- Yellow — Finance variance approval (owner: Rishi): pre-approved up to 8% credit once variance memo is in; Rishi to confirm by 2027-06-17.
- Green — Technical health (owner: Sean): 7-day health summary attached (small snapshot).

Bridge paragraph for PO (for procurement):
"Redwood Inference will provide a three-week bridge to cover July consumption conditional on Acme submitting a PO within three business days of the bridge start date. Any mitigation credit will be applied after receipt of a signed PO and is subject to Redwood's variance approval process."

Attachments added: acme_watchlist_sheet.xlsx (updated), acme_mop_terms_v2.pdf, health_7day_summary.pdf. DocuSign link for the MOP has also been re-sent: https://app.docusign.com/XYZ-ACME-MOP-2027

If all parties confirm, I'll close the loop with FP&A and move the deal out of the watch queue. Please reply "ACK" once you have actioned your owner items.

—Kim
